title: Logs show calibration has been accepted followed by cal has been deleted
body:
xDrip version: 67014b0-2020.07.25

G6 transmitter: 8J
Android 9
Motorola

I have unchecked Double Calibration under Settings, Less common settings, Advanced Calibration.
When I have needed to calibrate, I have used Initial Calibration under the top left menu (3 horizontal lines).

After entering the calibration, the readings on main screen show an impact.
But, the logs show: Calibration accepted by transmitter" in green.  And another log following in red: "Calibration with ID: *** appears to have been deleted".

Is the calibration successful?  Why is the red log present?

I can show an example of this issue in the facebook group:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4494106780662782/

comments.body:
There are some issues with the xDrip logs and messages since the G6 transmitter firmware updates by Dexcom.
I am closing this as it is a known behavior, which hopefully will eventually be resolved.
